teams.lead: All six of ART Grand Prix's teams' titles were won in the GP3 Series, and the last of them closed GP3 out in 2018
teams.note: GP3 ran from 2010 to 2018 and became the FIA Formula 3 Championship in 2019, so this record reaches across two championships wearing one label. ART Grand Prix won the first teams' title in 2010 and then the last four in a row, 2015 to 2018. The same operation also took 2011 and 2012 racing under its Lotus title sponsorship, entered as Lotus ART and Lotus GP, which is how those seasons are recorded here and why the count under the ART name is six rather than eight. It has not won a teams' championship since the rebrand. Prema Racing has five and every one is from the Formula 3 era — 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2024, five of the seven seasons run under the new name — so on current form the record changes hands as soon as Prema wins two more.
